rules: SHA256 binds physical file bytes; after an external edit the accepted entry becomes stale until affected evidence is rechecked.
Inventory enumeration is not object review. Assigned/reviewing files remain incomplete until independent review, validation and authorized coordinator commit receipts apply.
Record every declaration and relevant block. A group may share a proven contract only when its member symbols are enumerated.
Issues use unique ZCA-<assigned prefix>-NNN identifiers; source tags and issue entries must match exactly.
Preserve existing issue tags as historical entries without falsely asserting they were confirmed by this task.
Read-only and waiting paths remain pending completion requirements. Exclusion requires evidence of third-party, generated, cache, binary or pure-data status.
Do not store whole-file source copies in ledgers or evidence. References, scoped patches and hashes are sufficient.
